What This Fundraiser Is

We Want a Chiefs Christmas is a Kansas City–built holiday album supporting Rogue Round Table’s work to relieve school lunch debt and meet urgent food gaps across the metro.

When local families face rising costs, system delays, and empty shelves, KC steps up. This album is a joyful way to give back while celebrating the city we love.

Why Kansas City Needs This

KC is showing up everywhere — food drives, hygiene drives, school support, pantry volunteers — but need has outpaced supply. Families are slipping through cracks others never see.

Common issues reported this month:

  • Fresh food arriving spoiled
  • Expired canned donations
  • No formula, dairy, or meat
  • No soft foods for elderly and unhoused neighbors
  • Schools running out of snacks
  • Pantries stretched beyond capacity

This fundraiser provides flexible cash that fills real gaps in real time.
